applicable_rules: AGENTS §§1–6: Human sovereignty; capability != authority; current durable truth; scope/ownership; fail closed on material ambiguity; evidence-bound mutation; targeted reading.

Bootstrap §§1–3 + Recovery §§1–3.2: CRASH_TAKEOVER_OR_OLD_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE -> FRESH_CONTEXT from current Work Order/state; L0 first; ordered BOOT-1/2/3; single primary; durable bootstrap writeback.

Agent Interface §§1.0,1.3–1.8: isolated mutation workspace; eligible DIRECT requires bounded/reversible/deterministic authorized scope; continue legal work to existing acceptance; normal repair is not Human gate; retain required independent review.

Change Lifecycle §§2–4: branch/PR for governed artifacts; behavior/current-state change at least L1 with Issue; material schema/identity/canonical semantics/ownership/compatibility is L2 with Issue+ADR; exact-head review.
Durable Data §§1–7: identity, semantics, provenance, immutability, derivation, retention, migration must be answered in owner-local contract.
Durable Trace: semantic-stage checkpoints and exact recoverable pointers; local-only work is not remote durable completion.
Constitution §§3–8: native engineering facts, project-local ownership, evidence over self-report, proportionate independent verification; no automatic Incident/multi-verifier.
Reconnaissance §§2–7 applies before material architecture/reuse direction; frozen narrow implementation or live-revalidated same-scope report does not mechanically retrigger ARCH-0.
can_ignore: Workspace initialization/role registration, Human collaborator workflow, unrelated projects/private control plane, history, public cold-start checklist and old compatibility forwarders: no matching execution need.
Templates unless creating their artifact; separate capability report if applicable verified evidence exists; full repo/catalog/Internet scan; fixed freshness TTL; mandatory provider/Runner layer.
Planned-transfer REQUEST/READY/ACCEPTED or old chat/checkpoint retrieval as crash recovery prerequisites.
Global Architect approval for ordinary project decisions; Builder dispatch for eligible DIRECT work; automatic extra Verifier or model-consensus ceremony.
Bulk migration plan/mechanics unless actual scope meets §4.1 triggers; diagram protocol absent complex topology/lifecycle need.
Merge/deploy/admin execution: fixture grants none; lifecycle diagrams create no such authority.

source_proven.reuse: GitHub native relationships, labels, reviews, milestone and Projects for engineering durable facts; avoid duplicate prose status database.
Issue rationale/acceptance, ADR lasting decision, PR/diff/review, checks and Git history; reuse Git author/timestamp/parent metadata rather than duplicating every field.
Authenticated native GitHub first, authenticated gh fallback, local copy reconciled with remote refs.

native_capability_reuse.limits: Governance reuse choices, not proof of account/API capability. No undocumented feature asserted. Business archive/catalog remains in its owned store.

owner_local_design: Keep owned archive canonical. Catalog is bounded derived/rebuildable read model with source pointers and explicit freshness/invalidation/rebuild criteria when source or derivation logic changes.
Use existing project seams and proven native storage capabilities; avoid parallel identity/lifecycle/authority tracks. No database, external subsystem or schema is invented.
Owner defines keys/uniqueness/dedup; unknown/absent/not-applicable; provenance strength; mutable current view vs history; retention class; migration mappings/compatibility and recovery when needed.

Read bounds, permissions and concrete schema come from Work Order/project contract. Security/deletion/legal retention/backups remain owner-local; global doctrine gives no universal durations or private facts.
For remaining material architecture decisions, perform/revalidate targeted ARCH-0 with evidence-based project stage; owned archive alone does not establish maturity.

evidence.done: Compile finish predicate from durable Work Order acceptance: required deterministic/lineage checks, independent review for material schema, current exact candidate head and required durable report/commit/PR pointers. Repair in-scope failures. This reader performed no implementation or acceptance verification.
evidence.current: Fixture supplies VERIFIED authenticated access, current target HEAD/state and necessary Work Order facts. Real mutation/review must reconcile relevant live refs and reject drift; old-head evidence cannot establish current acceptance. No target HEAD value invented.
evidence.production: No production authority/execution/evidence supplied or exercised. Reader JSON, self-review, checks or model agreement cannot alone prove production readiness. Merge/deploy/admin remain outside authority.

extra_required_gates: Before claiming durable EXECUTION_ALLOWED, write Bootstrap/recovery conclusion to current writable durable anchor; one combined report suffices. This is a real source rule, not an old-artifact requirement.
Preserve single primary, scope, access/ref guards, independent review and execution hygiene. Necessary current facts are fixture inputs; do not invent a primary conflict or missing anchor.
Before material architecture/reuse judgment, ARCHITECT_READY needs applicable ARCH-0 or live-revalidated reusable evidence. This does not block fresh-context reconstruction.
recovery.decision: Crash recovery can proceed from supplied durable facts; no repeat Human prompt or old handoff required. Simulation makes no actual execution/completion claim.
